About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As a Staff Security Engineer on Security Incident Response, you'll serve as a senior technical leader and builder for the team, helping shape both how we respond to incidents today and how our response capabilities evolve over time.This role is about advancing what the team is capable of, not just responding when something breaks. You'll design and build the AI-assisted systems that extend the team's reach, lead the response to the most complex incidents, and own programs that make the organization more prepared over time, from tabletop exercises and gamedays to the continued advancement of threat hunting and insider risk capabilities.



You bring engineering depth, sound incident judgment, and the ability to plan, and deliver complex work against a longer-term maturity roadmap not just execute against a queue.



This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide impact on how 1Password investigates, contains, and learns from security incidents.



This role reports to the Manager, Security Incident Response.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - Significant experience leading complex, high-severity security incidents across multiple environments, including serving as an incident commander or equivalent technical lead.

 - Experience designing and building AI-assisted or agentic automation for security operations (triage, investigation, containment), with sound judgment about where automation should and shouldn't hold decision authority.

 - Strong software engineering skills, and experience building production tooling, automation, or systems rather than only operating existing security platforms.

 - Experience owning a security program or capability roadmap end to end, including planning, sequencing, and delivering multi-quarter work.

 - Strong understanding of cloud-native, SaaS, and identity-driven attack techniques and response approaches.

 - Experience designing and running tabletop exercises, gamedays, or comparable readiness programs and translating findings into improvements..

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to represent technical tradeoffs to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Experience mentoring engineers or otherwise raising the technical and investigative capabilities of a team.



How you'll work:

 - You look for opportunities to build systems that scale the team's capabilities rather than relying on repeated manual effort, and you're interested in thoughtfully applying AI and automation where they can improve security outcomes.

 - An experienced incident commander who brings structure to complex incidents, makes sound decisions with incomplete information, and helps teams move forward during high-pressure situations.

 - You're comfortable taking ownership of a capability from strategy through execution, including defining priorities, sequencing work, navigating dependencies, and delivering against a longer-term roadmap.

 - You can operate as a technical partner to leaders and cross-functional teams, independently representing technical priorities, risks, and tradeoffs.

 - You value continuous improvement and contribute to an environment where teams can examine incidents, decisions, and failures openly and turn what they learn into stronger systems and practices.



What you can expect:

 - Serve as incident manager and technical escalation point for complex, high-severity events, bringing structure, sound judgement, and clear decision-making under pressure.

 - Design and build AI-assisted and automated systems that improve how quickly and consistently the team can triage, investigate, and contain incidents.

 - Establish appropriate safety controls, approval gates, auditability, and rollback mechanisms for automated and AI-assisted actions, ensuring high-impact decisions remain appropriately human-controlled.

 - Own the team's readiness programs, including tabletop exercises and incident gamedays, from scenario design and execution through debriefing and translating finishes into concrete (or measurable) improvements

 - Advance the team’s threat hunting and insider risk capabilities by identifying opportunities, defining priorities, and delivering roadmap work that improves investigative depth and coverage

 - Plan, sequence, and deliver multi-quarter initiatives that mature the team's capabilities, bringing project management discipline to work that doesn't fit neatly into a sprint.

 - Mentor and provide technical leadership to other engineers, strengthening engineering rigor and investigative judgement across the team.

 - Partner with Security Operations, Product Security, and Engineering teams to close gaps surfaced through investigations, hunting, and simulations.

 - Foster psychological safety and blameless learning across incident retrospectives, gamedays, and tabletop debriefs.

 - Extend strong incident response practices beyond the immediate team by building reusable systems, tooling, and operating patterns that strengthen response capabilities across areas such as PSIRT, Privacy, and Engineering.



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $192,000 USD and $278,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $167,000 CAD and $242,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part.  Organization 
 Who We Are:  Durham Community Health Centre (DCHC) is a registered charitable organization that provides integrated, accessible, and equitable community-based primary care, wellness services, and health education for Durham community members facing barriers to health and well-being.
 Who We Serve:  DCHC offers equity-focused programs and services for priority populations, including Indigenous peoples, Black communities, 2SLGBTQI+ community members, newcomers to Canada, seniors, and clients without a family doctor. This approach helps community members access both preventive care and care when they are ill.

Together, we place each client at the centre of care and respond to their needs through integrated clinical care, wellness supports, and health education.
 Why Join Now:  This is an exciting time to join DCHC as we advance an energizing path toward greater impact in local health care. Guided by our Strategic Plan, Theory of Change, brand, client stories, and resources, we are diversifying, expanding, and strengthening how we serve the community.
 Position Overview 
 At Durham Community Health Centre (DCHC), we are committed to building healthier communities through accessible, high-quality healthcare services. As our technology environment continues to evolve, we are seeking an IT and Cybersecurity Services Coordinator to help ensure our systems, infrastructure, and information assets remain secure, reliable, and aligned with the needs of our staff, clients, and communities.

 Analyze and understand advanced threat vectors, including memory corruption, privilege escalation, side-channel attacks, and firmware exploitation. 
 Evaluate and build upon hardware-based protections such as Hypervisors, Trusted Execution Environments (TEE), and Secure Boot. 
 Design innovative security features that improve isolation, access control, exploit resistance, or threat detection. 
 Work closely with product teams to transition successful research into practical solutions and hardened products. 
 Monitor and assess emerging vulnerabilities, industry trends, and academic advancements.

 PhD / Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer/Electrical Engineering or related fields, with a research mindset and 3+ years of industry-relevant R&D experience is an asset. 
 Solid understanding of operating system internals, including memory management, process scheduling, and kernel/user separation.

 Experience with low-level system programming and debugging. 
 Familiarity with modern threat prevention technologies (sandboxing, CFI, ASLR, DEP, etc.). 
 Strong grasp of memory safety concepts, including buffer overflows, use-after-free, and heap exploitation techniques.

About us  
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.  
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.  
 But we don’t stop there.  
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.   
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.  
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.  
 The role 
 This is a lead from the front role.
 As Business Development Team Lead you will carry your own number and lead a team to carry theirs. You will be the example of excellence the team learns from, the operator who sets the pace, and the coach who lifts everyone around you. You keep a personal patch of strategic enterprise accounts and run it to the highest standard, while a share of your reward is tied to the performance of the team you lead.
 This is a deliberate design. We want a proven performer who wants to lead, not step back from the front line. You will show the team what great looks like by doing it, then multiply it across the region. As the function grows, so does the role, with clear career milestones that open up more scope, more leadership and more reward over time.
 You will partner closely with Field Sales Representatives, Marketing, Client Success and GTM leaders to turn account strategy into real engagement with executive level buyers. You will think commercially, communicate with clarity, and build genuine mastery of persona led value across financial crime, compliance, operations, client lifecycle, transformation and technology stakeholders.
 The BD Mission 
 Business Development is the activation layer for pipeline creation revenue growth across Fenergo's core markets. Our job is to find where Fenergo can create value, understand the business problem deeply, engage the right stakeholders, and build the conditions for qualified enterprise opportunities to progress.
 Success is not measured by volume alone. It is measured by the quality of account activation, the depth of discovery, the relevance of customer insight, and the progression of real enterprise opportunities into the revenue system. Your mission as Team Lead is to make that true for yourself and for every person you lead, and to make North America a benchmark other regions want to copy.
 What you'll do 
 Lead from the front 
 Carry your own patch of named enterprise accounts and run it to a standard the team can watch, learn from and aspire to.
 Set the pace on activation, discovery and opportunity progression. When you ask the team to do something hard, you have already shown it works.
 Be the visible example of excellence, on calls, in discovery, in account planning and in the CRM. 
 Build and develop the team 
 Coach reps on strategic outreach, discovery, multithreading and value creation, using your own live deals as the teaching material.
 Own onboarding and ramp for new joiners as the Toronto team scales, and build the playbooks, rituals and standards a new team needs.
 Run tight one to ones, pipeline reviews and skill sessions that raise the floor and lift the ceiling for every rep.
 Create a culture of high standards, accountability and genuine ambition, where record breaking is the expectation, not the exception.
 Activate strategic accounts 
 Develop deep understanding of named enterprise accounts, including their operating model, regulatory pressures, transformation priorities, technology landscape, stakeholder map and value drivers.
 Use internal insight, external signals, account research, customer triggers and AI powered tools to identify where Fenergo can create value.
 Engage senior and varied personas 
 Craft tailored messaging for stakeholders across Compliance, Financial Crime, Operations, Client Lifecycle, Technology, Transformation, Data and Commercial leadership.
 Understand what matters to each persona and communicate in a way that is relevant, credible and commercially sharp, and teach the team to do the same.
 Run high quality discovery 
 Use SPICED discovery to uncover the strategic problem, business impact, decision context, critical events and stakeholder motivations behind each opportunity.
 Determine whether there is a meaningful business problem worth solving, not simply whether there is interest
 Build value hypotheses 
 Develop clear, account specific value hypotheses that connect Fenergo's capabilities to the customer's priorities, pain points and desired outcomes, and help the team do this consistently.
 Multithread and mobilise 
 Engage multiple stakeholders across the account to build a broad understanding of the customer's priorities and buying environment, and move engagement beyond a single contact.
 Partner with Field Sales 
 Work as a close commercial partner to Field Sales Representatives. Align on account strategy, target personas, activation plans, messaging, discovery learnings and next step commitments.
 Earn internal credibility for yourself and your team through preparation, quality of insight, execution discipline and commercial judgement.
 Operate with data and rigour 
 Maintain quality activation plans, discovery notes and progression insight, and hold the team to the same standard.
 Use CRM and revenue tools consistently so account engagement, pipeline creation and opportunity movement are visible, measurable and actionable across the whole team.
 What Success Looks Like 
 You hit your own number and your team hits theirs, and Toronto becomes a benchmark for the wider BD function.
 Strategic accounts are activated with clear rationale, not generic outreach.
 Target personas understand why Fenergo is relevant to their business priorities.
 Early discovery produces meaningful customer insight, not surface level qualification.
 Field Sales receives stronger, better prepared opportunities from you and your reps.
 Value hypotheses are clearly documented and used to shape opportunity strategy.
 New joiners ramp faster because of the playbooks, coaching and standards you help put in place.
 You are recognised internally as a commercial operator and a leader who raises the quality of enterprise pipeline and the people who build it.
 What You Will Bring 
 We are looking for a proven performer with the appetite to lead. You have a track record you can point to, and you want to build a team that beats it.
 A strong track record in commercial SaaS, technology or B2B sales, with clear evidence of hitting and beating targets.
 Real front line credibility. You can sit on any call in the team and raise the level.
 Strong business acumen and the ability to understand complex customer problems.
 Confidence engaging senior stakeholders with relevance and professionalism.
 Strong discovery capability, ideally using SPICED as a framework.
 The instinct to coach and develop others, and the generosity to make the people around you better.
 Operational rigour. You run a clean pipeline, you use the tools, and you hold a standard.
 Goal orientation, resilience and high standards of personal execution.
 Curiosity about financial services, regulatory technology, onboarding and client experience for complex financial institutions.
 Comfort using data, account intelligence, AI tools and market signals to sharpen targeting and engagement.
 The ambition to grow with the role, through clear career milestones, as the Toronto team scales.
 What Will Motivate You 
 This role is a strong fit if you want to lead from the front and build something.
 Standing up a new team in a new region and setting the standard from day one.
 Leading while still selling, so you never lose the edge that got you here.
 A share of your reward tied to team performance, and a clear path to grow scope, leadership and reward through defined career milestones.
 Working on strategic accounts in a complex, high trust, high value sales motion.
 A category leading story to sell and a front row seat as that category is reinvented by AI.
 Taking the BD function in this region to record breaking heights as part of Fenergo's growth journey.
 What This Role Is Not 
 This is not a role for someone who wants to step off the front line. 
 It is not a pure management seat removed from the selling. It is not a scripted outreach or meeting setting function. It is not a handoff role where success ends once a calendar invite is accepted.
 This is a lead from the front role. You will carry a number, set the example, build the team, and help take Toronto to heights the region has not seen before.
 How You Are Rewarded 
 This is an individual contributor role with team leadership built in. Your compensation combines your own performance against your patch with a share tied to the performance of the team you lead. As you deliver and the function grows, defined career milestones open up greater scope, leadership and reward over time. We will walk you through the full structure during the process.
 Our promise to you   
 We are striving to become global leaders across all of the categories we operate in and as part of that we are a high-performing highly collaborative team that works cross functionally to accommodate our client’s needs.

 We help leading medical spas across the United States grow through paid advertising, AI automation, and patient acquisition systems. Our marketing generates hundreds of qualified patients every day who are interested in treatments like Botox, fillers, weight loss, and more.
 You are the friendly voice these patients hear first. Your job is to turn their interest into a booked, attended consultation, quickly, warmly, and consistently.
 We are currently serving 13 clients and scaling to 50 within 60 days. This is a ground-floor seat on a team in rapid growth mode, and top performers will have room to move into team lead and management roles.
 You are not cold calling strangers. Every person you contact already raised their hand: they clicked an ad, filled out a form, and asked about a treatment. Our current pain point is inconsistency. We need people who are skilled AND reliable, people who show up every single day ready to perform.

 High-Volume Outbound Calling
 Make 300+ dials per day using a power dialer system
 Contact new leads within 5 minutes of submission (speed to lead is the top priority)
 Respond to new Facebook and Instagram leads as they come in
 Cycle through older uncontacted leads after clearing all fresh leads
 Manage leads for up to 3 clients at once
 Appointment Booking
 Book qualified consultations for med spa and aesthetics clients
 Answer common treatment questions with confidence
 Handle objections professionally and warmly
 Confirm appointments by text and call, and keep no-show rates low
 Target 40+ booked appointments per client per month
 Lead Management
 Work company-generated leads, no cold prospecting required
 Prioritize leads by recency and engagement level
 Reactivate previous and dormant leads
 Follow structured call scripts while sounding natural, never robotic
 Track and report daily KPIs (dials, contacts, appointments booked) in GoHighLevel (GHL)

 Botox, Dysport, Xeomin, lip filler, facial filler, facial balancing, Radiesse, Sculptra, bio-stimulators, PRP, microneedling, weight loss (GLP-1), IV therapy, chemical peels, facial lasers, laser hair removal, skin tightening, and hormone therapy.
 You don't need to be a provider. You simply need enough hands-on experience to confidently answer common patient questions.

 You genuinely enjoy talking with patients about beauty, confidence, and self-care. You know how to make someone feel comfortable without sounding scripted. You build trust quickly, you stay organized, you love the follow-up, and you hate letting a potential patient slip through the cracks.

 Learn the power dialer, GHL platform, and call scripts
 Understand each client's practice, services, and ideal patient
 Demonstrate speed-to-lead discipline (5-minute response time)
 Ramp to full dial volume (300+ dials per day) by the end of the trial
 Begin booking appointments and tracking your daily KPIs
 Show up on time, every shift

 Hit 40+ booked appointments per client per month
 Maintain reliability: zero unexcused absences, on time every shift
 Grow your earnings through bonus performance

 Self-motivated and able to work independently from a home office
 Tech

 Your own laptop

 And when you hear of the challenge of building and leading a world-class organic media machine that needs to grow from 1.5M followers to 10M followers in the next 24 months... does that excite you? 
 If so - working alongside our founder Richard Yu and our company Impact Clients might just be your dream role... 
 Now, to be clear: 
 This is not a social media manager role.
This is not a “make posts and schedule content” job.
This is not a gig or a short-term contractor position.
 We're looking for a true executive, owner of tasks, and team builder who can grow to become a partner in our portfolio of companies. 
 Our Company Mission: To help ordinary people build extraordinary businesses online, and teach them the mindset and skills necessary to not just to make money, but more importantly to improve in all aspects of their lives.  
 Who We Are: We are an online education company that teaches people (9-5ers, busy parents, university students, etc) how to build thriving online digital product businesses.
 Why We Are Looking For This Role: Richard and our team have grown our social media accounts to 1.5M+ followers (Over 1 million on Instagram @richardyuzee (feel free to look), Richard Yu on Youtube (150K+ subscribers)... and we use organic content (meaning NO advertising or boosting posts) to drive leads (customers and qualified booked calls) to our coaching programs and digital software services that we offer. 
 You are essentially building the "Traffic Engine" that will supply our company with unlimited amounts of leads so our company can continue to serve and impact more and more people through the coaching and software products that we offer.
 Our Founder’s Story: Richard Yu began documenting his life at age 19 from his college dorm room in UCLA. Within 2 years, he launched a $500 productivity course (teaching college students how to wake up early and be productive), that ended up doing $500K in sales in 8 months. So many of his peers asked him “how did you do it?!” so he began to teach others how to monetize their knowledge and sell digital products (courses, PDFs, coaching, etc). 
 That grew into a consulting and education company that has now done over 30 million in sales and a team of 62 full time staff. 
 Feel free to reference a documentary made about his life here (1 hr documentary series): https://youtu.be/Ln4WCfGDKlk?si=KOTfrTF66JlXxcQ0 
 Also - Richard's TedX talk about how we get our clients results, and transform their lives: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AVeKqPlOcy4&t=6s 
 Our mission is to build one of the most influential organic-first personal media brands in the world with 10M+ followers across platforms while driving massive, profitable traffic into our software companies and education businesses .
 We strongly believe that income is a reflection of the impact we make on this world, and so through our content we aspire to positively impact 10M followers in the next 24 months. 
 We are intentionally shifting away from paid growth on social and moving 100% organic-first . 
 This role will own that transformation as the key leader, operator, and soon business partner in our company. 
 Current Context
 Instagram account with ~1M followers, generating multiple seven figures per year
 https://www.instagram.com/richardyuzee/  
 Two YouTube channels:
 Personal brand / vlog-style channel (~150K subs) https://www.youtube.com/@RichardYu1 
 Business education channel (~40K subs in https://www.youtube.com/@RichardYuBusiness 
 Existing team members:
 Dedicated Instagram copywriter
 Dedicated Instagram video editor
 YouTube scriptwriter / channel owner
 Graphic Designer (for all platforms) 
 Two Video Editors
 Marketing Leadership Team (that will support you, you will work alongside us)
 CEO and Founder (and actor talent in this case): Richard Yu
 COO 
 Head of Marketing (on the paid media side, so he leads every initiative and team of 10 people on the paid advertising side, this individual will be your accountability peer since you be the equivalent of him, but on the ORGANIC team side)
 You will lead , not replace, these people, and then build an even more talented team on top of it. 
 The perfect example of this role is this individual Sam that we respect, that is the Head of Organic Content for another company in our industry.
 Please watch this 60 second IG reel to understand what he does (and what we are looking for): 
 https://www.instagram.com/p/DR5v5cDD4lv/ 
 More context, full Youtube interview (extremely valuable where he breaks down their 8-figure/year media company: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lBY7oVXT-YE 
 Your Mission
 Build, scale, and lead the entire organic content ecosystem —starting with Instagram, then expanding outward into YouTube, short-form platforms, and written platforms—while earning the trust, respect, and performance of a growing content team.
 Operator FIRST Responsibilities: 
 First off - this is not a "creative first" type of role. If you just want to write copy all day for writing viral IG reels, please apply to be our copywriter (which we are always hiring for), not this role. 
 You will running L10 meetings (reference the book Traction, by Gino Wickman).
 You will be sharing screen and typing NAS (next action steps) for every individual that shows up to meetings, and host Mon/Wed/Fri stand-ups for 30-60 min as an organized disciplined operator and cut people off on the meeting (politely :-)) when they ramble to make sure meetings are efficient.
 You will be reading end of week reports that are both quantitative AND qualitative, and adding comments on the google doc to provide coaching and feedback to the Head of IG and Head of YT (and other team members).
 Again - you're an operator FIRST, logical thinker, highly organized and disciplined, with a strong understanding of organic content. 
 ALL channel leaders (Head of IG, Head of YT, Head of Linkedin, and any outside agencies/vendors will all report to you. Think of yourself as a COO of the media company, an extremely detailed project manager making sure everyone is getting their responsibilities done on time, and ensuring overall growth. 
 Richard wants to be fully removed from ALL day to day operations, so examples of things that Richard is doing that he does NOT want to be doing and you will take over completely are: 
 If the videographer uploaded the footage late 2 days and therefore IG content goes out late because the editors didn't get the raw footage in time... Richard is NOT calling this out. You are. And you are immediately creating an SOP/process (and tough conversation with the videographer if needed) so Richard does NOT have to do it. 
 If the content word-for-word scripts, which are due by 5 PM EST every Monday are submitted LATE by a copywriter, YOU are the one getting ahead of this and calling it out.
 If one video editor is approaching his 12 month term and is asking for a compensation bump, YOU are the one that is conducting the salary negotiation and structuring the comp structure so that it motivates the copywriter, and is sustainable for our P&L.
 Phase 1: Instagram Organic (Immediate Priority)
 You will work directly with our Head of Instagram to achieve 100,000 NET NEW followers gained per month (current growth: 70K/month followers)
 This includes:
 Leading the team of Instagram (Head of Instagram, 2 IG copywriters, 2 dedicated video editors for IG)
 You must fundamentally understand how to do each one of the below tasks (even if you're not the one directly doing it): 
 Conducting viral content research to find the most viral and trending content that exists
 Writing word for word teleprompter scripts for Richard to read off of when filming content that match his brand voice truly and sound like him
 Writing or approving copy 
 Exceeding existing KPIs of: views, new followers, and up front cash collected
 You must deeply understand Instagram before you can lead it.
 Phase 2: Instagram + YouTube
 Once Instagram is operating at a high level:
 You will oversee both Instagram and YouTube 
 The YouTube channel owner and scriptwriter will report to you
 You must understand:
 Long-form retention
 Thumbnails and titles
 Watch time and session growth
 Content packaging for education-based channels
 We do not believe in leaders who “manage” channels they don’t understand.
 Phase 3: External Traffic - Podcast Interviews and Speaking
 Once IG and Youtube systems are set up and growing at a consistent pace of 100K/month new followers on IG and 30K/month new subscribers on Youtube, you will own the expansion to getting Richard on well known top 50 podcasts to be interviewed by key thought leaders.
 This is key to helping Richard cross-pollinate with the audiences of other people's YT channels, podcasts, etc., 
 This way, we are able to gain 10,000 + new followers per month from OTHER people's audiences instead of relying only on our own growth 
 Taking all of the content and "mining" it into tactical 20-60 second long clips to be used for short form content that can go insanely viral by themselves.
 Phase 4: Short-Form Expansion (FB + TikTok)
 You will expand organic distribution to:
 Facebook (organic, not ads)
 TikTok
 This is not copy-paste repurposing from Instagram videos. Each platform has unique nuances, and you must be able to understand what they are and build a team, realistically growing or hiring a Head of FB/TK and coaching them up to excellence. 
 You must understand:
 Platform-native hooks
 CTA differences
 Formatting nuances
 Audience psychology differences
 Phase 5: Written Platforms (X + LinkedIn)
 You will eventually oversee:
 X (Twitter)
 LinkedIn (a major priority)
 This includes ghostwriting in the founder’s voice, narrative-based authority content, and business storytelling.
 Leadership Expectations
 We hire top-down .
 You must be able to:
 Hire and negotiate compensation
 Train and develop talent
 Run effective meetings
 Hold people accountable to output and performance
 Work with agencies short-term (3–6 months), learn from them, then build in-house
 This is an operator role, not an individual contributor role—though you must still have a strong personal content skillset.
 Who This Role Is For
 You have led organic growth before
 You’ve worked with creators or brands at hundreds of thousands to millions of followers 
 You want to build something massive—not just manage tasks
 You’re comfortable with ownership, accountability, and pressure
 You want to be a long-term partner, not a short-term hire
 Required: A Content Superpower
 You must clearly know your core creative superpower, such as:
 Cinematic videography / shooting
 Elite video editing / storytelling
 High-conversion copywriting / ghostwriting
 Visual direction / creative strategy
 You do not need to be great at everything—but you must be exceptional at something.
 In-Person Preference (Strongly Preferred, Not Mandatory)
 We strongly prefer candidates who:
 Can travel 1–2x per month to shoot content with Richard
 Are comfortable being on-location for filming
 Can work closely with editors and/or an on-site videographer who does the shooting.
 *NOTE: If you are not able to travel at all - this is totally understandable, and you will own the end to end hiring, training, and ongoing management of an onsite videographer. We are okay if we have to fly in a videographer every week, though it would be ideal to have someone local in Puerto Rico to shoot with Richard.
 Richard's expectations is that we shoot a full day every single week on Tuesdays with a videographer so we always have sufficient content. 
 Richard is based in Dorado Beach, Puerto Rico (you’re encouraged to look it up).
 Travel is not mandatory, but it is a major advantage.
 Compensation is flexible and merit-based .
 Performance-based growth expected
 This role is designed to evolve into a partner-level position :
 Potential profit share
 Potential equity discussions after ~12 months
 Exposure to software companies already valued at multiple eight figures 
 This is performance-dependent, not guaranteed.
 If you're still here.... this means you're interested. To apply, this is how it goes. 
 STEP 1: Fill out all the questions below, answering with as much detail as possible. One word vague answers will instantly be disqualified. For the loom, try to demonstrate what you've done before in the past. 
 STEP 2: Interview process is simple. Round 1 is with our Head of Ops and/or our Head of Marketing, and then round 2 will be with our COO. Final round (Round 3) will be with our founder/CEO Richard Yu.
 Finally, we'll give you a paid test assignment to demonstrate your work, leadership, and capabilities, and this can be discussed on the 2nd and 3rd round interview.
 That's it! 
 So go ahead and apply below! 
 P.S. If you know of anyone that is the perfect fit for this role, please send this form to them and tell them to list you as the "referral" (which is one of the questions belowed). If they are hired and stay on till day 45 with us, we'll personally wire/paypal/venmo (or however you'd like) $3,000.00 USD as a thank you for sending us our way.

Head of Marketing
 Town Web · HeyGov
Remote · Full-time contractor
 The Quick Version 
 Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts? 
 We did!
 Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry! 
 Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring. 
 Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.
 Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.
 Here's a video to tell you more about this role !
 The details 
 Who we are
 We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.
 Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)
 We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.
 What you'll own
 Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
 Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured. 
 Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
 Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
 The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
 Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.
 Who does well here
 Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? 😛Are you “THE ONE?” 
 We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.
 And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.
 AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.
 This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.
 What we need to see
 Exceptional Enthusiasm
 Extremely Creative Energy
 You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
 You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
 AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
 Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
 Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
 B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies
 Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!
 How to apply
 Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
 There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!
 IMPORTANT 
 Only applications submitted through the proper channel, which is Workable, will be processed.
 Taking the CultureIndex Survey is a requirement, we will not respond to any applications submitted without this.

Having a Contract Management team at Ashby allows our Sales team to focus on supporting prospective buyers on their journey to becoming an Ashby customer and existing customers expanding further into the product, while simultaneously allowing our Customer Success team to focus on the growth and success of our existing customers. With this harmonious relationship across the internal teams, we are able to make renewal and contract conversations meaningful and relevant to the needs of our customers, providing a top tier experience with Ashby.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

As an Ashby Contract Manager for Startup accounts, you will play a key role in supporting our revenue function and customer satisfaction with customers who are up to 100 employees. You will manage annual customer renewals, month-to-month customer subscriptions, contract questions, and will collaborate closely with a number of internal teams across Ashby’s largest customer segment. 

As a trusted guide to quickly growing and steady-state startups, you will need to secure early customer loyalty, guide non-recruiting personas through the renewal process, and provide hands-on assistance to customers. Attention to detail on a high volume of accounts will be essential, with an agile approach to secure continuing customers swiftly and solve for these smaller businesses creatively. 

With a focus on helping small startups begin to meaningfully grow their businesses, you will identify opportunities to support these businesses and identify high growth accounts. Your work as a Contract Manager directly impacts our broader business goals, with Ashby’s Operating Principles https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles woven into our processes.



This position requires expertise in core contract management competencies:

 - Navigating pricing and negotiation discussions with empathy and tact, while upholding a high level of respect for the value of Ashby and the services we render

 - Leading the renewal process with customers, ensuring timely and successful contract renewals, with terms that align to both the broader business goals and solve for the customer’s needs

 - Building and maintaining trust with customers, proactively addressing concerns and ensuring their subscription needs are met at time of renewal and throughout the customer lifecycle

 - Managing day-to-day administrative tasks, such as customer outreach, generating order forms, and CRM maintenance

 - Understanding contract terminology and how to communicate these terms to customers



Our ideal candidate will have a strong background in a combination of sales, customer success, and renewal management, with a proven ability to drive contract renewals and enhance customer relationships. In this role, you will work closely with our customers to ensure they receive maximum value from our offerings, ultimately contributing to customer retention and satisfaction. You will work in partnership with Sales and Customer Success to ensure that the right resources are engaged to maximize customer growth, driving expansion and renewal.



Ashby takes tremendous pride in our software; as such, we encourage all employees to have rich product knowledge. While the scope of your role does not require technical product aptitude, we will empower you with product knowledge to ensure you’re well-positioned for customer conversations (e.g. should tech stack pricing efficiency surface in a renewal, you are comfortable communicating our differentiators).




YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - You enjoy finding creative solutions for complex situations – this in turn will allow you to successfully solve for both the customer and Ashby

 - You are solutions-oriented – there is a solution to every problem or challenge we may face in Contracts

 - You are detail-oriented – we work across many different systems, with fact-checking and record-keeping a paramount priority for this contracts role

 - You are adaptable – you are able to be continuously learning and applying these learnings to your daily work

 - You excel at cross-functional collaboration, leveraging the right teams and colleagues to provide a top tier experience and solution for each customer, while being respectful of other individuals time, priorities, and goals

 - You have excellent communication skills over phone and email, and are able to navigate high pressure situations with ease and professionalism (strong public speaking skills translate well to this role)

 - You delight in having autonomy over your schedule — there is a high level of accountability at Ashby, and we rely on you to complete your work; while all of your work will be visible to the entire company, you will be responsible for managing your time

 - You display empathy in situations that require it – you understand where our customers are coming from and strive to find a solution accordingly

 - You value transparency – there is clarity and honesty in every step of our renewal process, and within Ashby as a company




YOU MIGHT NOT BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - You avoid taking ownership, and prefer to hand off various tasks

 - Dynamic situations make you uncomfortable 

 - You find pricing conversations and negotiations demanding and taxing

 - You do not enjoy admin work and prefer to be in face-to-face meetings all day

 - You find it challenging to devise creative solutions for complex situations, which may hinder your ability to effectively address the needs of both the customer and Ashby.  

 - You prefer to work independently and not collaboratively

 - You prefer a rigid schedule with limited autonomy, as you find accountability challenging

 - You have difficulty working remotely full time




OUR CULTURE

Our co-founders have written authentic pieces about Ashby’s communication https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/thoughtful-communication and operating principles https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles.  - Hiring Manager Interview: 30-45 minutes

ABOUT THE COMPANY 
 Our client is a deep-tech intelligence ecosystem building technology that enables organizations to understand, decide and act across complex real-world environments. 
 At the foundation of the ecosystem is a dedicated research capability that develops advanced technologies across multimodal intelligence, world models, temporal systems, signal processing and other emerging fields. These capabilities are productized through our client’s core AI orchestration platform and applied across industries including mobility, logistics, aviation, government, enterprise intelligence and critical infrastructure. 
 Our solutions connect intelligence with real-world operations - turning data from systems, sensors, cameras, geospatial environments and enterprise sources into actionable decisions and outcomes. 
 As they are expanding into North America, we are looking for a commercially astute, client-facing Solutions Architect who can translate complex business challenges into compelling technology solutions.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 The Solutions Architect will sit at the intersection of business, technology and the customer. This is not a purely technical architecture role. 
 You will work with prospective and existing customers across North America to understand how their businesses and operations work, identify high-value problems that technology can solve, and shape solutions using OUR CLIENT’s products, platforms and underlying technology capabilities. 
 You will lead technical and solution conversations from early discovery through solution definition, proposal and handover. You must be equally comfortable speaking with a CIO, business leader, operations executive, engineering team or technical architect. 
 The successful candidate will combine strong technical depth with business literacy, commercial judgement, emotional intelligence and executive-level presentation skills. 
 You will not simply respond to technical requirements. You will help customers define the right problem, challenge assumptions where necessary, and demonstrate how technology can create measurable operational and commercial value.
 WHAT YOU WILL DO: 
 UNDERSTAND THE CUSTOMER AND THE BUSINESS 
• Lead discovery conversations with customers to understand their business model, operating environment, strategic priorities, constraints and desired outcomes. 
 • Identify operational pain points, inefficiencies and opportunities where our client’s technology can create meaningful business value. 
 • Translate broad or ambiguous customer challenges into clearly defined technology use cases. 
 • Understand the commercial context behind a technical requirement, including value drivers, operational impact, scalability and return on investment. 
 • Ask the right questions before proposing the technology.
 ARCHITECT REAL-WORLD SOLUTIONS 
 • Design end-to-end solution concepts using OUR CLIENT’s platforms, products and technology capabilities. 
 • Translate customer environments into practical architectures spanning data, AI, geospatial intelligence, enterprise systems, sensors, cameras, edge environments and existing infrastructure where relevant. 
 • Determine how OUR CLIENT’s technology can integrate into a customer’s current technology and operational landscape rather than designing solutions in isolation. 
 • Consider requirements including security, privacy, data sovereignty, deployment model, integration, performance, scalability and operational resilience. 
 • Work with customers to move from problem → use case → solution architecture → business outcome.
 SHAPE PROPOSALS AND COMMERCIAL SOLUTIONS 
 • Partner closely with Commercial, Product, Engineering and R&D teams to develop customer propositions. 
 • Contribute to RFPs, RFIs, technical proposals, statements of work and solution presentations. 
 • Define solution scope, assumptions, dependencies, integration requirements and high-level implementation approaches. 
 • Help ensure proposed solutions are technically credible, commercially viable and aligned with genuine customer needs. 
 • Support the development of demonstrations, proof-of-concepts and solution narratives for strategic opportunities.
 CONNECT THE MARKET 
 • Develop a deep understanding of our client’s technology portfolio and how its capabilities can be applied across different industries and operational environments. 
 • Identify repeatable customer problems and emerging market opportunities across North America. 
 • Bring structured market and customer feedback into Product, Engineering and R&D. 
 • Help translate their underlying technology capabilities into relevant industry-specific propositions and use cases. 
 • Support the evolution of their North American solution strategy as the market develops.
 WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR: 
 • Significant experience in Solutions Architecture, Technology Consulting, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Transformation, Technical Pre-Sales or a closely related client-facing technology role. 
 • Experience working within a technology consulting firm, systems integrator, managed services provider, enterprise technology company or similarly complex solution environment. 
 • Strong experience engaging directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders. 
 • Demonstrated ability to understand business problems and translate them into technology solutions. 
 • Strong technical breadth across modern enterprise technology environments. 
 • Experience designing solutions involving multiple systems, integrations, data sources and stakeholders. 
 • Ability to understand and communicate solution architecture at both conceptual and technical levels. 
 • Strong business literacy and the ability to understand commercial and operational drivers behind technology decisions. 
 • Excellent presentation, storytelling and executive communication skills. 
 • High emotional intelligence and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments. 
 • Strong workshop facilitation, discovery and consultative problem-solving capabilities. 
 • Ability to operate effectively in environments where the problem or solution is not fully defined.

Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir.
 Le directeur ou la directrice, Stratégie des appels d’offres et tarification, dirige la façon dont Lyft Urban Solutions repère, élabore et remporte de nouvelles affaires. Ce poste réunit au sein d’une même fonction la stratégie commerciale, l’intelligence d’affaires, la planification de la demande et la gestion des appels d’offres. À titre de partenaire stratégique et de bras droit du chef de la stratégie commerciale et de la livraison, la personne titulaire pilote l'entièreté du cycle de poursuite des occasions d’affaires soit de la stratégie de marché et du positionnement avant les appels d’offres jusqu’au dépôt des soumissions et au transfert aux équipes de réalisation. Nous recherchons un ou une stratège aussi solide sur les plans commercial, technique et financier, qui dirige avec assurance ses équipes et des équipes multifonctionnelles.
 Lyft Solutions Urbaines (souvent appelé LUS) crée des programmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service que les usagers adorent, dont les villes ont besoin et que les exploitants apprécient. Nous concevons, fabriquons et soutenons les vélos et la technologie des stations qui font fonctionner des programmes de vélopartage dans des villes du monde entier, dont BIXI. Notre équipe de Montréal est au cœur de ce travail : elle réunit sous un même toit les équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'opérations, de marketing et commerciales.
 Responsabilités: 
 Stratégie commerciale, intelligence d’affaires et planification de la demande 
 Définir la stratégie commerciale avec le chef de la stratégie commerciale et de la livraison, notamment les marchés cibles, les régions prioritaires et les priorités de croissance.
 Diriger le ou la gestionnaire, Stratégie commerciale et planification de la demande, en matière de planification, de politique de tarification, d’intelligence d’affaires et de planification de la demande.
 Développer une intelligence d’affaires et une veille sur les appels d’offres (marchés, clients, concurrents et approvisionnement) qui orientent la stratégie, le carnet d’occasions et les décisions de poursuite.
 Assumer la planification de la demande et les prévisions du carnet d’occasions, en arrimant la capacité et les ressources de l’équipe des appels d’offres aux occasions anticipées et aux cibles de revenus.
 Avant l’appel d’offres, capture et décision de soumissionner 
 Responsable du processus à jalons décisionnels que suivent toutes les occasions en avant des appels d’offres, en cohérence avec la stratégie commerciale et les régions cibles.
 Réaliser des plans de capture pour les occasions stratégiques et ciblées, afin de façonner les occasions bien avant la publication des appels d’offres.
 Formuler les recommandations de soumissionner ou non, en présentant à la haute direction une vision claire de l’adéquation stratégique, du chemin vers le succès, des risques et du rendement financier.
 Stratégie et exécution des soumissions 
 Positionner chaque soumission pour gagner : définir dès le lancement les thèmes gagnants, la proposition de valeur, les éléments de différenciation concurrentielle et le positionnement tarifaire.
 Façonner les solutions et les offres commerciales avec les équipes d’exploitation, techniques, des finances et des affaires juridiques, afin qu’elles soient concurrentielles, réalisables et rentables.
 Élaborer et remettre en question les modèles financiers, la tarification et les analyses de rentabilisation des soumissions, en veillant à ce que chaque soumission respecte les seuils de marge convenus.
 Instaurer une planification rigoureuse des soumissions, avec des jalons, des étapes de revue, des responsables et des échéances claires.
 Leadership et partenariats 
 Diriger et faire grandir une équipe composée de gestionnaires d’appels d’offres, de spécialistes, de coordonnateurs et coordonnatrices ainsi que du ou de la gestionnaire, Stratégie commerciale et planification de la demande, comme une seule fonction très performante.
 Diriger avec autorité les équipes multifonctionnelles de soumission et tenir les contributeurs responsables du respect des échéances.
 Prendre des décisions opportunes et assurées en contexte d’ambiguïté, en équilibrant les risques et le potentiel de gain.
 Faire le lien entre les ventes, les appels d’offres, les contrats et la réalisation, afin que ce que nous vendons puisse être livré de façon rentable.
 Expérience: 
 Plus de 12 ans d’expérience dans des rôles liés aux appels d’offres, à la capture d’affaires, au développement commercial ou au développement des affaires, dont plus de 5 ans à diriger des équipes à titre de gestionnaire principal, de directeur ou l’équivalent.
 Sens commercial et des ventes : un historique de succès dans des appels d’offres d’envergure et complexes, et une solide compréhension des cycles de vente, des relations clients et du positionnement de marché.
 Esprit stratégique : capacité à saisir les occasions, à définir la stratégie de soumission et à formuler des recommandations claires à la haute direction.
 Compétences techniques : capacité à comprendre et à façonner des solutions techniques et opérationnelles, à échanger de façon crédible avec les experts et à transformer les exigences en offres convaincantes et réalisables. À l’aise avec les données, l’intelligence d’affaires et les outils de planification.
 Solides compétences financières : maîtrise de la modélisation financière, de la tarification, des états des résultats, des flux de trésorerie et de la gestion des marges, et capacité à défendre les données financières des soumissions auprès des finances et de la haute direction.
 Leadership assuré : capacité à bâtir des équipes très performantes et à influencer les parties prenantes de haut niveau de différentes fonctions.
 Maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit (la connaissance d’une troisième langue est un atout). La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour collaborer avec les équipes de Lyft, ainsi qu’avec des clients et des partenaires en Amérique du Nord et à l’international.
 Atouts : expérience avec les méthodologies APMP ou Shipley, expérience des appels d’offres dans plusieurs régions et parcours combinant appels d’offres et réalisation.
 À quoi ressemble la réussite (12 premiers mois)

Senior DevOps Engineer, Agentic Automation & Live Games
 Toronto, ON
Hybrid, 4 days per week in office
Full-time
Department: Engineering
Reports to: Engineering Leadership
Compensation range: CAD $140,000 to $180,000
 About Big Viking Games
 Big Viking Games is a Canadian gaming company focused on building, operating, and growing long-standing online game communities. Our games have entertained players for years, supported by loyal audiences, live operations, evolving content systems, product innovation, and deep player-driven economies.
 Our flagship titles, YoWorld and FishWorld, have served millions of players over their lifetime. These are enduring live-service virtual worlds with rich in-game economies, virtual goods, social interaction, and long-term player engagement at their core.
 We are entering a new phase of modernization and growth, with a focus on stronger infrastructure, better automation, practical AI adoption, improved reliability, stronger security practices, and scalable systems that help our games and teams perform at a higher level.
 About the Role
 Big Viking Games is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer, Agentic Automation & Live Games to modernize the infrastructure behind our live-service games and help reinvent how those systems are operated.
 This is a hands-on senior infrastructure role for someone fluent in modern cloud operations: AWS, containers, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, observability, production reliability, incident response, security, and automation.
 But this is not a traditional DevOps role.
 We are looking for someone who can build automation that does real work, not just scripts that run or dashboards that summarize. The right person has started using agentic coding tools, tool-calling systems, API integrations, workflow automation, or MCP-style tooling to safely diagnose, provision, remediate, monitor, or maintain infrastructure.
 Our games run on mature systems with real players, real revenue, real constraints, and real consequences. There is meaningful room to automate how they are operated, but the work must be done with discipline. Uptime, data integrity, least-privilege access, rollback paths, auditability, and production safety matter.
 The defining trait for this role is self-direction. Given a backlog, you improve how the work gets done. Left to your own judgment, you find repetitive operational work nobody has flagged, decide what is worth automating, and build it safely.
 This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, with an expectation of working in office three days per week. Live-service games require operational awareness outside regular business hours, including periodic on-call and incident response availability.
 What You’ll Do
 Build Agentic Automation for Infrastructure Work
 Design, build, and operate agentic tooling that performs real DevOps work, including diagnosis, remediation, provisioning, routine maintenance, and operational follow-up.
 Build and maintain the integration layer that lets tooling act safely on our systems, including API integrations, MCP-style servers, webhook-driven orchestration, serverless functions, and permission-controlled automation.
 Convert manual runbooks, SOPs, recurring maintenance tasks, and repetitive operational chores into automation that can run unattended where appropriate.
 Establish guardrails that make automated action against production defensible, including least-privilege scopes, dry-run modes, approval paths, logging, audit trails, rollback plans, and clear escalation rules.
 Use agentic coding tools to accelerate infrastructure work, including IaC authoring, migration scripts, incident analysis, log analysis, documentation, and operational troubleshooting.
 Help improve how the wider engineering team uses automation and AI-assisted tooling safely and effectively.
 Own and Modernize Live Production Infrastructure
 Monitor, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure across AWS, Netlify, Vercel, and related platforms supporting our live games, data systems, internal tools, and operational workflows.
 Drive infrastructure modernization while maintaining uptime for live games with active player communities.
 Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Pulumi, or similar tools.
 Improve CI/CD pipelines, release workflows, deployment reliability, and environment management so teams can ship safely and frequently.
 Operate containerized workloads and GitOps-based deployment patterns.
 Improve local development, build, test, deploy, and production support workflows.
 Help manage cloud usage, resource tagging, environment efficiency, and infrastructure cost discipline.
 Reliability, Observability, and Security
 Rebuild and improve observability across the stack, including logging, metrics, alerting, dashboards, and operational visibility.
 Pay particular attention to early detection of silent failures, pipeline failures, data freshness issues, and degraded production behavior.
 Maintain and monitor data pipelines between game source databases, Snowflake, and downstream analytics and reporting systems.
 Own secrets and credential lifecycle management across platforms, including API key rotation, access controls, environment variable governance, and least-privilege practices.
 Support incident response, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and post-incident improvements.
 Automate the parts of incident response and remediation that repeat.
 Create documentation, runbooks, and SOPs that are executable wherever possible, not just descriptive.
 Improve backup, restore, disaster recovery, access review, and production-readiness practices.
 What You Bring
 Experience
 7+ years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, or a similar role.
 Strong hands-on experience designing, maintaining, and improving production infrastructure.
 Experience supporting live production systems where uptime, reliability, data integrity, and performance matter.
 Experience working with mature or legacy systems that predate modern cloud-native patterns.
 1+ year building with agentic coding tools, tool-calling systems, workflow automation, or infrastructure automation that takes real action.
 Experience with systems such as agents wired into pipelines, MCP-style integrations, automated diagnosis, automated remediation, provisioning workflows, or production-safe infrastructure tooling.
 Experience identifying repetitive operational work and turning it into reliable automation.
 Core Technical Skills
 Strong hands-on experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.
 Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Pulumi, or similar, including shared state and team-based workflows.
 Experience with containerized applications, especially Docker.
 Experience with container orchestration such as Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, or similar, including debugging real production issues.
 Experience with GitOps and declarative deployment tools such as ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent.
 Experience with CI/CD tooling, version control, deployment automation, and modern release workflows.
 Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, cloud security, monitoring, logging, and operational troubleshooting.
 Experience establishing observability, including choosing tooling, defining alerts, tuning alert noise, and creating useful dashboards.
 Experience with relational databases such as MariaDB, MySQL, or Postgres, including replication, backup, verified restore, and schema changes against systems that stay online.
 Security-aware mindset with practical experience in secrets management, credential rotation, access control, vulnerability reduction, and least-privilege practices.
 How You Work
 Self-starting. You identify the work rather than waiting for it to be assigned, and you can explain why one problem matters more than another.
 Proactive about toil. You notice repetitive work and treat it as a defect to be engineered away, not a cost of doing business.
 Inventive but pragmatic. You reach for novel approaches where they genuinely help and recognize when a simple script is the better answer.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex infrastructure or production issues, including silent failures and data pipeline outages.
 Comfortable working directly with engineers to improve build, deploy, and operational workflows.
 Practical ownership mindset with the ability to prioritize, execute, and close loops.
 Strong communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Calm under pressure during incidents, escalations, and ambiguous production issues.
 Nice to Have
 Experience supporting live games, virtual worlds, multiplayer systems, or other real-time online products.
 Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms.
 Experience with Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, ELK, OpenTelemetry, or similar observability tooling.
 Experience with Redis, Memcached, queues, workers, or event-driven systems.
 Experience with Snowflake, data warehouse connectivity, ETL monitoring, or data pipeline reliability.
 Experience with serverless platforms such as Netlify Functions, Vercel, AWS Lambda, or similar.
 Experience operating multi-platform hosting environments.
 Experience with disaster recovery, backup strategies, incident management, load testing, and performance tuning.
 Experience improving cloud cost management, tagging, resource optimization, or infrastructure governance.
 Experience evaluating where automation should not be applied, including cases where human approval or human judgment remained necessary.
 Experience working in small, high-leverage engineering teams where infrastructure ownership is broad and hands-on.
 Ideal Candidate Profile
 The ideal candidate is a senior infrastructure engineer who keeps live systems stable while systematically removing the manual work involved in keeping them that way.
 They are not a tool collector. They understand uptime, production risk, cloud cost, security, release quality, operational discipline, and the failure modes of automation. They know that automation acting on production needs guardrails, observability, rollback paths, and human approval where risk demands it.
 They work independently. Given a mature live game and a broad remit, they can identify what matters, sequence it sensibly, and improve systems incrementally without disrupting what is already working.
 They are comfortable being the person who decides what gets automated next, what should remain manual, and what needs stronger controls before it can safely run unattended.
 This role suits someone who wants deep ownership of production infrastructure and a real mandate to modernize how live-service games are operated.
 Compensation
 The expected compensation range for this role is CAD $140,000 to $180,000, depending on experience, technical depth, infrastructure ownership, agentic automation experience, and overall fit.
 Benefits
 Group Retirement Savings Plan matching and participation.
 Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision coverage.
 Health and Wellness spending account.
 Generous time off policies.
 Opportunity to support long-running live-service games with established player communities.
 Deep ownership of cloud modernization, DevOps automation, security improvement, and agentic infrastructure workflows.
 A high-impact role with meaningful ownership over reliability, performance, and engineering operations.
 Hiring Process and AI Disclosure
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.
 Big Viking Games may use AI-assisted tools at some steps of the recruiting process, including application review support, candidate research, interview preparation, scheduling support, and workflow administration.
 AI does not make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by people.
 Every interviewed candidate will be informed of their status within 45 days of their final interview.
 Accessibility and Accommodation
 Big Viking Games is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. We welcome applications from individuals of all abilities and will provide accommodations throughout the hiring process as needed.
 If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact hr@bigvikinggames.com so we can work with you to support your needs.
 Application Note
 When you apply, tell us about infrastructure automation you have built that performed real operational work.
 We are especially interested in what it did, what systems it touched, how you made it safe, what guardrails you built, how it failed, and what manual work it eliminated.

About us:  
 At Red Rabbit Robotics, our mission is to tackle the global labor shortage and create a future of abundance. We aim to deploy one million humanoid robots in the next 10 years. Our robots are designed to tackle manual labor across manufacturing, warehouse, logistics and more. Our “teleoperation first” strategy immediately delivers value by providing humanoid labor as a service through remote operators, while simultaneously building a powerful data flywheel that fuels the foundation models for robotics and leads to full autonomy for physical world AI.
 Founded just a few months ago, we have already built two generations of humanoid robot prototypes, secured venture backing, and attracted major customers eager to try out our solution. With real time human oversight and a powerful data flywheel, we are building embodied AI systems that can work in the real world in the same way as we do. Check out our prototype demo videos at www.redrabbitrobotics.ai .
 What we believe: 
 We are all about our customers. We talk to real folks in the industry to find out what they actually need, then we build products that solve those problems. Simple as that.
 We are agnostic to different technical approaches. There is no single “silver bullet” for real world robotics. We stay open-minded, keep learning, and try whatever works best.
 We keep it practical. For example, our robots have wheels, not legs (no backflips in the near future). We don’t waste time over-engineering fancy features that don’t make a real difference for our customers’ success.
 The role: 
 We’re looking for a Robotics Engineer to own the design and implementation of our humanoid robot’s control systems. A major responsibility in this role is helping us evaluate and select the right technology stack. You’ll be deeply involved in real-time control loops, sensor fusion, actuator integration, and higher-level motion planning algorithms. This role is in person for our Vancouver, Canada office.
 What you will do: 
 Design, implement, and optimize real-time control architectures (manipulation, navigation, teleoperation).
 Investigate and compare frameworks and algorithms to guide our core software platform decisions.
 Integrate sensors (LiDAR, vision, IMU, force/torque) and actuators (BLDC servo motors).
 Develop algorithms for motion planning, kinematics, and advanced control strategies.
 Collaborate closely with hardware and operations teams to ensure cohesive system integration.
 Create testing procedures for both simulation and real hardware to validate performance and reliability.
 What you will bring: 
 Proficiency in C++ or Rust (experience with ROS/ROS2 is a big plus).
 Strong foundation in control theory, kinematics, and dynamics of robotic systems.
 Proven track record of shipping code code for commercial or open-source robotics projects that have high impacts. 
 Experience with real-time embedded systems and safety-critical software.
 Excellent problem-solving skills and a willingness to adapt and learn.
 Hands on experience building and debugging electrical and mechanical systems.
 Knowledge of machine learning for robotics and advanced motion planning.
 Background using simulation tools like Gazebo, Mujuco or Nvidia Isaac Sim.
 Being able to speak Chinese and communicating with our vendors directly is a bonus.
 This role requires shifting working schedules and travelling to the US from time to time.
